name: Carbon
role: Anode-side conductive host and SEI carbonate former. sp2 carbon (graphite/VGCF/amorphous carbon) is the electronic-percolation matrix and Li intercalation host (LiC6); Li2CO3 is a principal inorganic SEI carbonate.
ionic_radius_note: Shannon (1976): C4+ CN3 = -0.08, CN4 = 0.15, CN6 = 0.16 A. Covalent radius ~0.76 A (sp3), ~0.73 A (sp2) is more physical for graphitic C. Approximate.

representative_compounds.battery_role: sp2 electronic-percolation network (VGCF 1D fiber, amorphous carbon), Li intercalation host; semimetal
representative_compounds.note: D/G Raman fingerprint; ID/IG tracks disorder. VGCF used in our campaign as SE-domain conductive agent.

representative_compounds.battery_role: stage-1 graphite intercalation compound, 372 mAh/g anode; baseline vs Li3N/nitride interphase
representative_compounds.note: gold-colored, sqrt3 x sqrt3 R30 Li ordering; Li donates 2s electron into graphene pi* band -> metallic. C 1s shifts slightly below graphitic 284.5 eV from metal-C charge transfer.

representative_compounds.battery_role: major inorganic SEI carbonate (passivating but ionically resistive); also sulfide-SE/moisture and CO2-reduction byproduct
representative_compounds.note: XPS C 1s ~290 eV (carbonate CO3), Raman nu1 symmetric stretch ~1090 cm-1. Wide-gap insulator.

sei_relevance: Li2CO3 is one of the dominant inorganic SEI carbonates on carbon/Li anodes: C 1s ~290 eV, Raman ~1090 cm-1, passivating but Li+-resistive; forms from electrolyte/CO2 reduction and surface reaction with moisture, and can further react to LiF/Li2O ladders. Graphite staging (LiC6 <-> LiC12 <-> ...) sets the anode potential plateau. VGCF/amorphous carbon itself is not an SEI phase but provides electronic percolation and can catalyze electrolyte decomposition at high surface area.

xps.ref: Anal. Chem. 2016 (origins of sp3 C1s); a-C studies

raman.assignment: G band, E2g in-plane sp2 stretch (crystallinity)

raman.ref: Ferrari & Robertson, PRB 2000; graphene Raman reviews

raman.assignment: Li2CO3 nu1 symmetric CO3 stretch (SEI carbonate marker)
raman.ref: carbonate Raman studies; battery-interphase IR/Raman/XPS database arXiv:2310.13871

dos_character: Graphite is a semimetal: C 2pz-derived pi/pi* bands overlap slightly at the Fermi level (small but finite DOS at E_F near K/H points), while sigma bands from C 2s/2px/2py sit well below. Upon lithiation to LiC6, Li 2s electrons fill graphene pi* states, raising E_F and making the compound metallic (Li nearly fully ionized, Li+). Li2CO3 is a wide-gap insulator (~5 eV), consistent with its passivating/electron-blocking SEI role. Refs: Holzwarth et al., PRB 18, 5190 (1978) Li-graphite DOS; stage-1 Li-GIC DFT (arXiv 2006.12055).
oxidation_states_note: 0 in graphite/VGCF; -4 in Li carbide-like; +2 CO; +4 in Li2CO3/CO2 (SEI-relevant).
key_references: Ferrari & Robertson 2000, Phys. Rev. B 61, 14095 - D/G bands and interpretation of disordered/amorphous carbon Raman
Holzwarth et al. 1978, Phys. Rev. B 18, 5190 - Li-graphite band structure, DOS, Fermi surface
Wood & Teeter 2018, ACS Appl. Energy Mater. (NREL) - inorganic SEI XPS incl. Li2CO3, charge-correction methodology
Origins of sp3 C peaks in C 1s XPS 2016, Anal. Chem. - sp2/sp3 C 1s assignment
Battery-interphase IR/Raman/XPS database 2023, arXiv:2310.13871 - Li2CO3/organic SEI fingerprints
campaign_note: Our campaign has an internal LiC6 (0001) Li-adatom NEB baseline (db/interphases/lic6.json, tools/neb_diffusion) used as the graphite reference vs Li3N interphase. Those are our own DFT/MLIP absolute values and are intentionally NOT imported into the numeric fields here.
